frame.operatorLabel: {name}: sign out, switch person or language
frame.offline: Offline: work waits on this tablet

menu.switch: To switch person, the next person scans their badge.

helpDialog.title: Help
helpDialog.body: Ask your team leader, or the office.
helpDialog.later: Calling for help from the tablet comes later.

languageDialog.title: Language
languageDialog.body: For this screen only. After sign-in the screen speaks your own language.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.message: You will be signed out of this tablet soon. Saved work stays.

unavailable.title: The factory server does not answer
unavailable.body: Check the factory Wi-Fi, then try again.

scan.title: Scan the set-up code
scan.where: In the office: Admin › Devices & printers › the device › Set-up code. Hold the tablet over the QR code.
scan.label: Set-up code
scan.hint: The code works once, for 15 minutes.
scan.cameraHelp: No scanner yet? Use the camera. If Android asks, allow the camera for this app.

codeInvalid.title: This code does not work
codeInvalid.body: It was used already, it ended after 15 minutes, or it is for another factory. Make a new one in the office.

offline.title: Set-up needs the network
offline.body: Connect the tablet to the factory Wi-Fi, then scan again.

unavailable.title: The factory server does not answer
unavailable.body: Try again in a minute. The code stays valid for 15 minutes.

rateLimited.title: Too many tries
rateLimited.body: Wait a few minutes, then scan a new code.

replace.title: Replace this tablet's set-up?
replace.afterValue: The new code decides what it becomes. The old set-up stops working on this tablet.

binding.title: This tablet is now
binding.office: Change it in the office: Admin › Devices & printers.

app.title: App on the home screen
app.manualSteps: Open the browser menu (⋮) and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

storage.title: Keep the data on this tablet
storage.notKeptWhy: Android may clear what waits on the tablet. Install the app, then ask again.

checks.title: Check the parts
checks.scannerHint: Scan any label to test it.
checks.printer: The printer test comes with the station's printer, after sign-in.

kiosk.title: Lock the tablet to the app
kiosk.step1: Open the app from the home screen.
kiosk.step2: Android Settings › Security › App pinning: switch it on.
kiosk.step3: Open Recent apps, tap the app's icon, then Pin.
kiosk.step4: To unpin: hold Back and Recent apps together (the office knows the PIN).
kiosk.honest: Android does not tell an app whether it is pinned: press Home to test it.

done.title: Ready
done.bodyNoStation: This tablet is set up at {site}, with no station.

badge.title: Scan your badge
badge.label: Badge
badge.scanOnly: Scan it: a badge typed by hand is not taken.

names.title: Pick your name
names.empty: No one is set up for this site yet. Ask the office.

forgot.title: Forgot your PIN?
forgot.body: Your team leader or the office resets it. You choose a new one at your next sign-in.

problem.wrong: This badge or PIN does not open this tablet. After 5 wrong PINs a person is locked for a few minutes. Ask your team leader.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries on this tablet. Wait a minute.
problem.unavailable: The factory server does not answer. Try again.
problem.operatorActive: Someone else is signed in on this tablet. Ask them to sign out.
problem.pinNeeded: This site signs in with a badge and a PIN.

signedOut.idle: You were signed out after a time without use.
signedOut.ended: Your sign-in ended (shift end, or the office). Sign in again.

switch.title: Switch person
switch.body: {name} is signed in. The next person types their PIN.

change.title: Choose a new PIN
change.current: Type the PIN the office gave you
change.rules: Six digits. Not one digit six times, not digits in a row (like 123456), not your employee number.

problem.mismatch: The two PINs were not the same. Start again.
problem.refused: Choose another PIN: this one is too easy to guess.
problem.wrong: That is not the PIN the office gave you. Type it again.
problem.repeat: Not one digit six times. Choose another.
problem.run: Not digits in a row. Choose another.

notice.title: Worker notice
notice.heading: Worker notice
notice.means: This records that you saw this notice. It does not sign anything else.
notice.blocks: Scans wait until you have read it.
notice.languageNotReady: Your language is not ready on screen: HR gives you a paper copy in your language.

none.title: No notice to read
none.body: No worker notice is in force for this company.

newer.title: A newer version is in force
newer.body: Read the new version: it opens now.

unavailable.title: The notice did not open
unavailable.body: The factory server does not answer. Try again.

home.title: Home

hint.cutting: Scan a hide to cut it, or a bundle to fix its ticket.
hint.sewing: Scan a bundle ticket to report it.
hint.packing: Scan a carton, a lot or a work order to open it.
hint.inspection: Scan a work order to inspect it.
hint.warehouse: Scan a work order to pick for it, or any label to open it.
hint.none: Scan any label to open it.

empty.title: Nothing to do here
empty.body: Nothing to do here with your role at this station. Ask your team leader.

notice.title: New worker notice
notice.body: Read it when you have a minute.
notice.blocks: Read it before your first scan.

home.badgeRefused: This badge does not open this tablet. Ask your team leader.

offline.queues: No network: your work is saved on this tablet and sent when the network is back.

held.receive: No network: receiving goods waits for the network (a receipt and its lots take their numbers from the office). Other work is saved on this tablet.
held.inspect: No network: inspections and releases wait for the network (they take their number from the office). Scans are saved on this tablet.
held.serials: No network: garment serials and their labels wait for the network (the office gives them). Other work is saved on this tablet.

hint.mywork: This station's queue: what comes next
hint.operation: Report a bundle at your operation
hint.cut: Check a hide and log what you cut
hint.bundles: Make bundles and print their tickets
hint.receive: Receive goods and print the hide tags
hint.pick: Issue materials to a work order
hint.pack: Scan garments into cartons, print labels and the DDT
hint.labels: Print garment labels behind the certificate check
hint.machine: Report a machine problem; a technician’s jobs

scan.title: Scan anything
scan.label: Scan any label
scan.hint: Bundle, hide, lot, work order, location or machine tag.

camera.error: The camera did not start. Allow it in Android, or use the scanner.

scan.empty: Scan a label: its card opens here.

hide.notUsable: Do not cut this hide: its lot is not released.

notOnFloor.title: {type} label read
notOnFloor.body: Its card is not on the tablet yet. Ask the office.

scan.noPermissionBody: Your role at this station does not open them. Ask your team leader.

otherFactory.title: This label is not from this factory
otherFactory.body: Check the label, or ask your team leader.

typo.title: This code has a typo
typo.body: It was misread or mistyped. Scan it again.

notFound.title: Nothing found
notFound.body: Nothing you may open on this tablet has this code.

badge.title: This badge does not open this tablet
badge.body: The person signed in stays. Ask your team leader.

unavailable.title: The factory server does not answer
unavailable.body: Scan the label again in a minute.

machine.locked: Do not use this machine: it was marked unsafe and waits for a technician to sign it safe.
machine.doNotUse: Do not use this machine: the office set it do-not-use.
machine.retired: This machine is retired: its tag no longer reports problems.

sync.title: Waiting to send

update.queue: A new version of the app waits for this queue to empty. It updates by itself afterwards; nothing waiting is lost.
update.network: A new version of the app waits for the network. It updates by itself when the network is back.
update.screen: A new version of the app waits until this screen is done. It updates by itself on the home screen.

sync.needsNetworkDiscard: Discarding needs the network: the office is told at once.

problem.unavailable: The office did not answer the last send. The actions stay on this tablet and are sent again.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again and the actions are sent.

clock.behind_one: This tablet's clock is {count} minute behind. Tell the office.
clock.behind_other: This tablet's clock is {count} minutes behind. Tell the office.
clock.ahead_one: This tablet's clock is {count} minute ahead. Tell the office.
clock.ahead_other: This tablet's clock is {count} minutes ahead. Tell the office.

storage.low: Space low: {mb} MB left. Tell the office.
storage.mayClear: The browser may clear this tablet's data: install the app and tell the office.

numbers.lowOnline_one: Only {count} {what} number left: more come with the next send.
numbers.lowOnline_other: Only {count} {what} numbers left: more come with the next send.
numbers.lowOffline_one: Only {count} {what} number left on this tablet. Connect to the network to get more.
numbers.lowOffline_other: Only {count} {what} numbers left on this tablet. Connect to the network to get more.

refused.title: Refused, with a fix
refused.others_one: Another person has {count} refused action: the team leader sees it.
refused.others_other: Another person has {count} refused actions: the team leader sees them.

waiting.title: Waiting, in send order
waiting.offline: No network. It sends by itself when the network is back.
waiting.again: Saved on this tablet, tried before
waiting.others_one: Another person has {count} action waiting on this tablet: it is sent when they sign in.
waiting.others_other: Another person has {count} actions waiting on this tablet: they are sent when they sign in.

detail.final: It will not pass as it is.
detail.notFinal: It is sent again by itself with the next send.

discard.title: Discard this action?
discard.body: It will not be recorded. Your team leader sees that it was discarded.

UNKNOWN_BUNDLE.message: This is not a bundle ticket of this site.
UNKNOWN_BUNDLE.fix: Scan the bundle's ticket again, or ask your team leader.

REPLACED.message: This ticket was replaced by a new one.
REPLACED.fix: Discard it and scan the new ticket.

WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN.message: The work order is not open (on hold, done or cancelled).

PREVIOUS_NOT_REPORTED.message: The operation before this one is not reported yet (it may still be on another tablet).
PREVIOUS_NOT_REPORTED.fix: It is sent again by itself; if it stays here, ask your team leader.

FLOOR_NOT_READY.message: Work is held at this site until its floor is ready.
FLOOR_NOT_READY.fix: It is sent again by itself once the floor is ready; ask your team leader.

NOT_RESERVED.message: This label number is not one of this tablet's numbers.
NOT_RESERVED.fix: Discard it, print a new label and put it on instead.

BLOCK_CLOSED.message: The number block of this label was closed by the office.
BLOCK_CLOSED.fix: Discard it, print a new label and put it on instead.

ALREADY_USED.message: This label number was used before.
ALREADY_USED.fix: Discard it, print a new label and put it on instead.

NOT_ALLOWED.message: The person signed in may not do this at this site.
NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Ask your team leader for the role, or discard it.

BAD_EVENT.message: This tablet kept the action with something missing or wrong.
BAD_EVENT.fix: Discard it and do it again.

UNKNOWN_KIND.message: The office does not take this kind of action from the tablet.
UNKNOWN_KIND.fix: Discard it and update the app; ask your team leader.

CLIENT_ID_REUSED.message: This tablet used one action's id for another action.
CLIENT_ID_REUSED.fix: Discard it and do it again.

HIDE_USED_UP.message: The hide is used up: its cuts are final.

ALREADY_REPORTED.message: This bundle was already reported at this operation.

NOT_FOUND.message: What this action names is not on record here.
NOT_FOUND.fix: Discard it, scan the label again or ask your team leader.

CONFLICT.message: The office could not record it now.
CONFLICT.fix: It is sent again by itself; if it stays here, ask your team leader.
